name: Rashida A. Adams
office: Presiding Justice, Court of Appeal, Second District, Division Three

items.text: Rashida A. Adams has been Presiding Justice of the Second District Court of Appeal, Division Three, since 2026. She previously served as an associate justice, and a Los Angeles Superior Court judge for juvenile dependency and criminal cases from 2017 to 2023. She tracks cases to decide the oldest appeals first. She authored a 2026 opinion reversing an anti-SLAPP denial. She wrote a 2024 opinion on probate assignment rights.
